title: Preserve an acknowledged retired-check disposition across an Engram reader switch
outcome: When the original Engram tracker acknowledges a retired-check note as the project changes its store or connection, TermAl keeps the exact disposition receipt scoped to the original registration and refuses the stale evaluation. A later request on the original store reuses the receipt.
acceptance: A behavioural test changes the store or connection while the note is in flight, returns a valid acknowledgement from the original tracker, and shows that the stale evaluation is refused and the exact receipt remains durable on the original registration.
After restoring the original reader, a retry reuses the acknowledged receipt without writing another audit note.
